validation.name: Validator admission control
validation.productionRisk: Validation sprawl, unclassified hard fails/warnings, and validators bypassing the matrix.
validation.whatItProves: Every validation/test/smoke/audit/deploy package script is admitted, classified, severity-labeled, and routed through matrix/orchestrator authority.
validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Does not prove every admitted validator passed; validate:everything or specific proof lanes must run.
validation.failureHandling: HARD FAIL blocks delivery because repo governance cannot prove docs/validators are controlled.
validation.ownerDecisionNeeded: YES if failing or if a validator/doc needs retirement/reclassification.
validation.blockerPolicy: HARD FAIL blocks delivery because repo governance cannot prove docs/validators are controlled.

validation.name: Docs consolidation admission

tierPolicy.tier1: Static/source/docs/env/security/contract proof only. No browser, deploy, or provider completion claim allowed.
tierPolicy.tier2: Tier 1 plus local build and local browser/self-spawn/runtime proof. No deployed/provider completion claim allowed.
tierPolicy.tier3: Ultimate release gate for this provider-backed repo: Tier 1 + Tier 2 + deployed/postdeploy proof + every real-provider lane. Missing deployed/provider evidence is a HARD FAIL for COMPLETE.
tierPolicy.tier4: Not used. Human/business approval is signoff overlay, not validation tier.
tierPolicy.warningPolicy: ZERO ADVISORY NOISE: release proof lanes are either HARD FAIL or INFO / NO VALIDATION.

zeroWarningPolicy.rule: No validator may emit advisory noise as a default pass state. Diagnostic checks must be INFO / NO VALIDATION or HARD FAIL when risk is real.
zeroWarningPolicy.reason: Warnings create operator noise and unclear release authority. Every validator must have explicit owner, tier, proof layer, and blocker policy.
